iceBreaker.heading: 🧊🔨 Ice-breaker
iceBreaker.question: What are Daniel and Eugenia's love languages for both giving and receiving love?
iceBreaker.note: 5 Love Languages: Words of Affirmation, Acts of Service, Receiving Gifts, Quality Time, Physical Touch

items.text: Brotherly friendship between two friends Daniel and Eugenia, as they spend Monday nights playing basketball together
Romantic love between Daniel and Eugenia as we celebrate tonight as they are united in marriage
Familial love shared among family members: Daniel, Jannie (Daniel's mom), Justin (Daniel's dad), Diane, Joshua, Eugenia, Jackie (Eugenia's mom), Wilson (Eugenia's dad), Marco (Eugenia's brother)
The unconditional, sacrificial, selfless love of God. The love Daniel and Eugenia share for everyone here tonight is a reflection of God's unconditional love for them first.

scripture.heading: 📖 1 John 4:10-12; 19
scripture.text: This is love: not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son as an atoning sacrifice for our sins. Dear friends, since God so loved us, we also ought to love one another. No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God lives in us and his love is made complete in us. … We love because he first loved us.

insight.heading: 💭 Some Insight
insight.text: The 4 biblical expressions of love are woven in Daniel and Eugenia's story but it reminds us that their love is ultimately rooted in the love God has for us, for when he died on the cross for our sins.

questions.text: When you hear that God loves you unconditionally and sent Jesus to die for you, what thoughts or questions come to mind?
subs: What is one way someone has shown you unconditional love? How did it impact you?

questions.text: Which of these four types of love have you experienced most strongly in your life?

iceBreaker.heading: 🧊🔨 破冰话题
iceBreaker.question: Daniel 和 Eugenia 在付出与接受爱的时候，各自的爱的语言是什么？
iceBreaker.note: 五种爱之语：肯定的言词、服务的行动、接受礼物、精心的时刻、身体的接触

items.text: 朋友之间的友爱——Daniel 与 Eugenia 作为朋友，每逢星期一晚上一起打篮球。
Daniel 与 Eugenia 之间的爱情——今夜我们一同庆贺他们结为夫妇。
家人之间的亲情：Daniel、Jannie（Daniel 的妈妈）、Justin（Daniel 的爸爸）、Diane、Joshua、Eugenia、Jackie（Eugenia 的妈妈）、Wilson（Eugenia 的爸爸）、Marco（Eugenia 的哥哥）。
神那无条件、牺牲、无私的爱。今夜 Daniel 与 Eugenia 向在座每一位所分享的爱，是源于神先爱他们的那份无条件的爱。

scripture.heading: 📖 约翰一书 4:10-12；19
scripture.text: 不是我们爱神，乃是神爱我们，差他的儿子为我们的罪作了挽回祭，这就是爱了。亲爱的弟兄啊，神既是这样爱我们，我们也当彼此相爱。从来没有人见过神，我们若彼此相爱，神就住在我们里面，爱他的心在我们里面得以完全了。……我们爱，因为神先爱我们。

insight.heading: 💭 默想
insight.text: 这四种圣经中爱的表达交织在 Daniel 与 Eugenia 的故事里，但这也提醒我们：他们的爱最终是根源于神对我们的爱——因他为我们的罪死在十字架上。

questions.text: 当你听见神无条件地爱你，并差耶稣为你而死，你心中浮现什么想法或疑问？
subs: 曾经有谁以无条件的爱待你？那件事如何影响了你？

questions.text: 这四种爱之中，哪一种是你生命中体会最深的？
